description: Symon Points overlay window. Scopes IPC to the 'point-overlay' label so the click-through /point-overlay webview can receive o8:point-show / o8:point-hide and animate the pointer. Without a capability whose `remote.urls` matches the bundled-Next origin AND whose `windows` includes 'point-overlay', Tauri injects no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ into this remote-URL webview, so listen() never attaches and the pointer never paints. Label-disciplined: events only, NO window-control / updater / process / shell perms (those stay main-only).
